subject: OPEN statement
notes: kb/Work PB326, landed. BOTH halves now hold. (a) Nothing opens a report file connector implicitly — the OPEN really must precede the INITIATE. (b) The violation is DETECTED: §14.9.21.4 GR3 is the detection half of this rule, and CobolReport.Initiate now tests CobolFile.OpenModeIfOpen(_fileName) against {Output, Extend} and, when it fails, calls ExceptionState.ReportFileModeError (raise gated by >>TURN per §14.6.13.1.1) and RETURNS without taking any action on the report — GR3's 'no action is taken on the report', which is unconditional. OpenModeIfOpen was added rather than reusing OpenModeOf because the §14.9.49.4 GR6b view also answers with the ATTEMPTED mode of a FAILED open, so an INITIATE after an unsuccessful OPEN OUTPUT would have proceeded. The golden's three arms are: never opened; open in the INPUT mode (the arm an is-open-only test passes); and the two modes GR3 permits, output and extend. Before this landing EC-REPORT-FILE-MODE was a catalogue row (ExceptionCatalog.cs, L3 Fatal) with no raise site anywhere in src. kb/Work PB688 (2026-09-05): the golden moved from tests/conformance/2002 to tests/conformance/2023 - it observes the report by re-reading the report file through ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL, which is a COBOL-2023 introduction (12.4.5.10.3 GR2; the Foreword's main-changes list over ISO/IEC 1989:2014), so the program is not expressible at 2002. The RULE's editions are unchanged.
